decisions.statement: The worker and the tray each write their own line shape.
A reader says which of the two that reader is reading.
A line opens with the time the line was written.
That time is written in UTC.
The worker writes that time to the millisecond and the tray to the second.
The rest of the line is the message.
A line the shape does not fit is answered as nothing.

definition: one line of a temper watcher log read as its time, its level and its message
